review_note: Reading commissioning and Torin-Sifan procurement issues adversely affected first-half profitability and management made margin improvement a stated focus; adjusted margin declined 20bps, while second-half efficiency recovery, 14.6% revenue growth, higher cash inflow and lower net debt supplied strong contrary evidence.

Supply-chain and inflationary pressure was specific but contained; adjusted margin expanded 530bps to 20.9%, operating cash flow rose 31.2% with 97% conversion, and record revenue, profit and resumed dividends supplied multiple strong quantified contrary indicators.

Inflation and market headwinds were contained through pricing, cost control and factory efficiency; adjusted margin increased to 21.3%, cash conversion reached 106%, leverage was 0.8x and revenue, earnings and acquisition progress supplied multiple strong quantified contrary indicators.
